name: Dranik Sewers
summary: The corrupted undercity of Dranik, once vital waterways now infested with Muramite forces and Discord energy.
description: The Dranik Sewers were once the lifeblood of Dragorn civilization, channeling water, trade, and travel beneath the surface. After the Muramite invasion, the sewers were seized and converted into hidden war camps, torture pits, and supply tunnels. Discord corruption seeped into the waterways, warping the stone and spawning horrors in the depths. Resistance enclaves attempt infiltration, but the Muramite presence is overwhelming. The Sewers connect directly to deeper catacombs and warfronts, forming the underbelly of Kuua’s conflict.
